static_traits.name: Lin Yiwen
static_traits.social_status: Has several friends to chat about Average topics with, but not yet discussed Self-doubt with them; distanced from colleagues at Work due to perceived inadequacy
static_traits.medical_history: without significant physical illness;without previous psychotherapy or psychiatric history;not yet had similar psychological problems before
static_traits.language_features: Nervous but willing to express; highly cooperative; able to clearly describe experiences and thoughts; self-criticism and negative automatic thinking present; under guidance able to carry out reality testing and rational analysis

basic_info.main_problem: I keep feeling that I am losing my talent in making cars, because the last car did not sell quickly, which leads to Self-doubt and Anxiety.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these Self-doubts affect my Work performance and overall well-being.
growth_experiences: About a month ago, the last car's sales were slower than Anticipated; the client developed the cognition 'losing one's talent' from this; afterwards in Work scenarios, seeing colleagues' cars sell faster intensifies Self-doubt and Anxiety; due to pressure (deadline and financial pressure) and continued rumination, Work Decreased drive, distancing from colleagues, appetite and Sleep affected.

Last year, designed a car that sold quickly and was well received; at that time the client, by devoting effort to the design and absorbing earlier customer feedback, achieved success, and this experience for a time strengthened confidence and a sense of accomplishment.

core_beliefs: I am not as talented as my colleagues

special_situations.event: The last car's sales progress slower than Anticipated
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a car sells slowly, it means I have no talent or am losing my talent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Extends working hours and proactively seeks others' feedback to prove herself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am losing my talent; my work is not good enough

special_situations.event: Seeing colleagues' cars sell faster at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not perform as well as colleagues, it equals I am not good enough/have no talent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Distancing from colleagues, Avoids communication to avoid shame
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them; they must think I am not good enough

special_situations.event: When reviewing past performance, only focusing on the fact of the most recent poor sales
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only sustained, every-time fast sales count as talent; a single success is not enough to prove ability
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring positive evidence, Reinforcing negative self-evaluation to urge improvement
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Past successes do not show I really have ability

special_situations.event: Even when considering market factors (such as a slower market that month or more popular car models), still attributes the outcome to their own ability
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If results are not ideal, the main cause must be me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-blame, reducing communication with others to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my fault,I am not good enough

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as talented, work affirmed by the market and praised by peers
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being compared and judged as not good enough, fearing failure and shame
defense_goal: Keeps distance from others to avoid being compared and humiliated
Proves self-worth through self-pressure and overtime

object_relations.object_representation: More excellent colleagues/market evaluators who may judge oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When seeing colleagues' cars sell faster at Work or being compared When comparing oneself with others
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Others will negate me like judges; I will lose face
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding in avoidant language, shortening answers, reducing details, lowering emotional exposure, and ending the topic.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking about expressing one's Self-doubt and Anxiety to friends or colleagues
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If expressed, I will be looked down upon or trouble others
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Avoiding talking about Self-doubt, shifting to Average topics instead, masking unease with a light tone, not touching personal feelings.

manifestations: Distancing from colleagues at Work due to shame and inadequacy
Having friends but not talking about inner Self-doubt and Anxiety
outcomes: Shaken sense of subjective meaning and self-worth

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves.
manifestations: Not expressing Self-doubt and Anxiety to friends, choosing to bear it alone
Solves problems through overtime and self-pressure rather than seeking external support

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequent Self-denial ('I am not good enough''I have no talent')
Overly cautious in interpersonal contact, reducing communication for fear of being evaluated

positive_force: Has had clear successful experiences and can summarize effective strategies (valuing customer feedback, investing in design)
Willing to seek feedback and professional help (proactively working overtime, seeking counseling help)
With guidance, can consider external factors (market rhythm, car model preferences)
Having some Social support (friends to chat about Average matters with)
negative_force: Strong Self-denial and comparison tendency (attributing one slow sale to insufficient ability)
Overly personalized attribution, ignoring positive evidence
Social avoidance (distancing from colleagues) causing Decreased support and Increased sense of loneliness
Persistent anxiety and rumination affecting sleep and appetite, further weakening Work performance

target_behavior.behavior: Self-doubt and Anxiety in Work scenarios
antecedent: While at work seeing colleagues' cars sell faster
Thinking about the last car's slow sales
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizing one slow sale as insufficient ability, engaging in negative comparison and dependence on external validation, leading to Self-denial
target_behavior.function: Avoiding being judged and feelings of failure; trying to maintain control and promote improvement through self-criticism
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance, continued rumination, Anxiety intensified

antecedent: Feeling ashamed or inferior at Work
target_behavior.core_reason: Shame- and inferiority-driven Social avoidance to reduce the risk of being compared and evaluated
target_behavior.function: Escapes social evaluation and negative emotional triggers
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased interpersonal support, Increased sense of loneliness, limited collaboration and resource access

target_behavior.core_reason: Continuous psychological pressure and rumination causing cross-system physiological rhythm disorders
target_behavior.function: Unintentional physiological reaction (short-term escape from pressure experience)
target_behavior.consequence: Physical condition declines, further affecting work and emotion regulation
